reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Small Molecule Collagen Firming Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: Eye cream to reduce wrinkles in the skin and reduce dark circles around the eye, works but requires a lot of time to see results. Use the product for over two months. Good for reducing wrinkles but does not completely remove the dark circles.
reviews.zh: 減少皮膚皺紋同淡化眼圈嘅眼霜，有用但要好長時間先見到效果。用咗兩個幾月。對減淡皺紋有效，但就唔可以完全消除眼圈。

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Small Molecule Collagen Firming Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: It does feel firming, but it also feels a little drying. I have to go over it with moisturizer after.
reviews.zh: 用完確實有緊緻感，但又覺得有少少乾。之後我仲要再補多次保濕霜。

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Small Molecule Collagen Firming Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: Not drying at all. Instant smoothing/blurring affect under the eyes. I am excited to see how it works over time.
reviews.zh: 完全唔乾。即時平滑／霧化眼底效果。好期待睇下用耐啲效果會點。

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Small Molecule Collagen Firming Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: Finally found an eye cream that is hydrating enough! You don’t need a lot. It’s thick and it spreads easily. I need need about half the amount seen in the picture. The rest I use for my smile lines.
reviews.zh: 終於搵到一支夠保濕嘅眼霜！唔使搽好多。質地厚但好容易推開。我大概只需要圖片份量嘅一半，剩低嘅我就用嚟搽笑紋。

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Small Molecule Collagen Firming Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: Started to use it very recently. So far I can tell is light and moisturising. Hopefully I get to see some effects with regular use!
reviews.zh: 啱啱先開始用。暫時用落覺得質地清爽又保濕。希望持續用會見到啲效果！

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Small Molecule Collagen Firming Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: I bought this eye cream for my mom — she’s 60 and was looking for a good cream to help reduce the appearance of fine lines. She really loved it, so I definitely recommend it!
reviews.zh: 我買咗呢支眼霜畀我媽媽——佢 60 歲，揀緊一支可以幫手減淡細紋嘅好嘢。佢用完真係好鍾意，所以我自己都好推薦！

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Small Molecule Collagen Firming Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: Llevo usándolo 2 semanas, aún no he visto muchos resultados😅 lo he estado usando por las noches pero espero q ayude a que no se m formen arrugas y a reafirmar. No irrita y se absorbe rápido
reviews.zh: 我已經用咗 2 個星期，到依家都未見到好多效果😅我一直都喺夜晚用，希望可以幫到我唔好再形成皺紋同埋令皮膚收緊返。唔刺激，吸收得好快。

reviews.shade: Torriden Cellmazing Small Molecule Collagen Firming Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: The Torriden Cellmazing line is quickly becoming one of my faves. Ive been using this eye cream for around 3 weeks and have noticed small changes around my under eyes. They are brighter and have slightly but noticeably smoothed out some of the fine lines. It's lightweight & soaks in really well. You don't need alot a very small amount goes a long way
reviews.zh: Torriden Cellmazing 呢個系列好快就變咗我嘅心水之一。我用咗呢支眼霜大概 3 個星期，發覺眼底附近有少少變化。眼底提亮咗，啲細紋都有明顯少少被撫平。質地輕盈，吸收得好好。唔使搽好多，搽好少少已經好襟用。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
